title: PGC Surface Contract Schema V0
description: Closed machine-block contract for SURFACE_CONTRACT artifacts. Every field is read by assert_topology_surface_canonical_v0 when building the exact and prefix lookups that canonicalize a capability surface.

surface_contract_code.description: Reported as the governing contract in canonical-surface violations.

governs.description: Capability ids governed by this contract; the exact-lookup key together with op. May be empty when the contract is reached by capability_id_prefix instead.

canonical_surface.description: The closed set of result statuses admissible for this capability/op pair.

capability_id_prefix.description: Optional prefix-lookup key, applied when no exact (capability_id, op) match exists.

fqdn.description: Authoritative declared identity (namespace::code). Folder location has no authority over identity.
